vibe_rationale: Fifteen-year showcase of independent publishing that is free and curated, with prizes and a closing party; a single scene.
fit_notes: Adult, design-literate readers and publishers across the region, with weak wellness adjacency. Medifé, a health insurer, is a past partner, so there is some health-sector precedent. A commissioned book or reading lounge would suit better than signage. Activation in person would need an Argentine partner.
